name: zcode-switchman
description: Fixed six-lane sub-agent fleet for ZCode: shells self-provision at session start (bodies auto-sync, default model: inherit), model per shell is a user-set frontmatter line, ROUTE_META dispatch discipline, mismatch guard, and a failure breaker.

description_i18n.en: Fixed six-lane sub-agent fleet for ZCode: shells self-provision at session start (bodies auto-sync, default model: inherit), model per shell is a user-set frontmatter line, ROUTE_META dispatch discipline, mismatch guard, and a failure breaker.
description_i18n.zh-CN: ZCode 固定六档子代理编队：会话启动自动装配六壳（正文自动同步、默认 model: inherit），模型由用户一行 frontmatter 自设；ROUTE_META 派发纪律、错配拦截与失败熔断。
